name: VideoVault DaVinci Resolve Extension
releaseNotes:
- VideoVault now sees much more of your work in DaVinci Resolve Studio. Besides which project and timeline you have open, it now reports when you change the edit, add or remove markers, add colour nodes or switch colour versions, and when you move between the Media, Edit, Color, Fairlight and Deliver pages.
- Importing media, playing back and scrubbing through the timeline are now counted, so time spent reviewing shows up as work.
- Renders are reported from start to finish, with progress, and a render that fails or is cancelled is reported as such. Short renders that finish within a few seconds are no longer missed.
- When you close a project, VideoVault also records how long you worked in it.
- Only project and timeline names are shared. Your media and clip names are never read.
